correctness.rationale: For every n>=5 the VC upper argument forces a forbidden path-end edge when n−1 edge queries are positive except one; the lower argument constructs a Hamiltonian cycle for every subset of n−2 path queries, including all small component cases. At 3<=n<=7, the finite recurrence exhausts all degree-two graph incidence vectors and possible query-support patterns. Complete lower trees (up to depth six with 64 distinct terminal witnesses) and exact upper checking, including a symmetry-reduced 176-state two-factor and 86-state Hamiltonian positive-branch obstruction at n=7, prove the dimension pairs. Two independently represented generators and support algorithms agree. No extrapolation of finite checks supplies the universal proof.

value.rationale: The all-order VC formula is a sharp invariant for two natural and closely related non-matroid spanning graph classes. The support that realizes all 2^(n−2) patterns can be prescribed as a path and witnessed with connected graphs despite degree constraints. The first strict online-vs-static dimension separation occurs at a natural smallest order n=6, and Hamiltonian and all-two-factor classes share exact dimensions yet differ in complete finite support profiles. This supports a concrete open problem for larger-order adaptive dimension, not a renaming or isolated unmotivated small case.
